source.name: Specialized: Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe Short Sleeve Race Jersey (product page)
source.quote: Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe team graphics
source.note: Title sponsor and majority owner of the team. The 2026 race jersey (this page's renders + the team's kit-launch article of 15 Dec 2025, https://www.redbullborahansgrohe.com/en/news/flying-look-red-bull-bora-hansgrohe-takes-off-with-a-style-update, launch photo https://img.redbull.com/images/q_auto,f_auto/redbullcom/2025/12/14/ihddp3ryrjwwoe7qwntz/2026-jersey-of-red-bull---bora---hansgrohe) shows the Red Bull bulls and wordmark filling the centre of the chest and the upper back, and on the thighs of the shorts.

source.name: Specialized: Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe Short Sleeve Race Jersey (product page)
source.quote: Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe team graphics
source.note: Title sponsor. On the 2026 race jersey (renders on this page + team kit launch of 15 Dec 2025, photo: https://img.redbull.com/images/q_auto,f_auto/redbullcom/2025/12/14/ihddp3ryrjwwoe7qwntz/2026-jersey-of-red-bull---bora---hansgrohe) 'BORA' sits under Red Bull on the chest and the upper back; 'BORA hansgrohe' marks the blue shoulders; 'BORA' runs down the sleeve fronts, both shorts legs and the collar tape.

source.name: Specialized: Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe Short Sleeve Race Jersey (product page)
source.quote: Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe team graphics
source.note: Title sponsor. On the 2026 race jersey (renders on this page + team kit launch of 15 Dec 2025) 'hansgrohe' sits under BORA on the chest and upper back, in the green under-arm side panels, on the blue shoulders, on the collar tape and across the back of the shorts. hansgrohe's own site confirms the sponsorship: 'hansgrohe has been a proud sponsor of the Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe UCI WorldTeam since 2017' (https://www.hansgrohe.com/about-us/sports-sponsorship).

source.name: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe: Flying Look — Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe takes off with a style update
source.quote: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe enters the 2026 season together with Specialized with a new look – while staying true to its own history.
source.note: 'grenke' sits on the upper-left chest below the collar on the 2026 jersey — visible in the launch photo https://img.redbull.com/images/q_auto,f_auto/redbullcom/2025/12/14/ihddp3ryrjwwoe7qwntz/2026-jersey-of-red-bull---bora---hansgrohe (worn by the riders, front row, on the chest at collar height) and in the race-worn photos of the collection article (https://www.redbullborahansgrohe.com/en/news/260106-rbh-collection-2026). grenke is also title sponsor of the team's junior squad, grenke – Auto Eder.

source.name: HUGO BOSS press release: BOSS announces sponsorship of Red Bull-BORA-hansgrohe cycling team
source.quote: during competitions, the BOSS logo will be prominently featured along both sleeves and across the center of the jerseys
source.note: On the 2026 jersey 'BOSS' runs vertically down both sleeves and appears small on the upper chest (team launch photo of 15 Dec 2025 and Specialized's race-jersey renders, both cited above).

source.name: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe: Mewa extends its partnership with Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe
source.quote: The new contract provides for greater visibility of the textile service provider. This includes logo placement on jerseys and team vehicles.
source.note: 'MEWA' marks the red cuff bands on both sleeves of the 2026 jersey (team launch photo of 15 Dec 2025, cited in the Red Bull entry).

source.name: Red Bull – BORA – hansgrohe: Ready for takeoff — our new collection is now available
source.quote: The collection follows the design approach developed together with Specialized
source.note: Kit manufacturer (per the convention for kit suppliers). Specialized sells the replica as the 'Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe Team Short Sleeve Race Jersey ... worn by some of the world's best riders' (https://www.specialized.com/us/en/red-bull-bora-hansgrohe-short-sleeve-race-jersey/p/1000277927); its S-logo sits on the chest above the 'UCI WORLD TEAM' device, on both rear shoulders, on the lower back with the SPECIALIZED wordmark, on the shorts and on the helmet.

source.name: Specialized: Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe Short Sleeve Race Jersey (product page)
source.quote: worn by some of the world’s best riders
source.note: 'AUTO EDER' appears in small type at the very top of the jersey's back, below the collar; visible on the back render of the official 2026 race-jersey replica on this page (image RBH-RACE-JERSEY-SS-LTD-WHT-RB-BLU_BACK). Auto Eder is also co-title sponsor of the junior team grenke – Auto Eder.

summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam. Title sponsors Red Bull, BORA and hansgrohe fill the chest and upper back; grenke sits on the upper chest, BOSS down both sleeves, MEWA on the sleeve cuffs, AUTO EDER at the top of the back, and the kit is made by Specialized, whose logo also appears. Every placement checked on the team's launch photos, race photos and Specialized's official replica (front, back, both sides).
